dataset_name: API Documentation Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) & Drift Corpus
dataset_source: APIstic: Large-Scale OpenAPI Evolution Dataset (ACM MSR 2024 / Zenodo 20525072)
description: Sentence pairs of API descriptions mined from APIstic commit histories annotated with cosine similarity [0.0 to 1.0], semantic drift, and meaning shift flags for fine-tuning Student 2's Bi-Encoder Sentence-Transformer.

train_pairs.text1: Returns all catalog products across all distribution centers without restriction.
train_pairs.text2: Returns available products only. Inactive and discontinued items are excluded.

train_pairs.text1: Creates an order immediately and synchronously charges the user's card.
train_pairs.text2: Queues the order for asynchronous batch processing. Card charged on fulfillment.

train_pairs.text1: Cancels an active subscription immediately. Pro-rated refund issued.
train_pairs.text2: Schedules cancellation at the end of billing cycle. No refunds issued.

train_pairs.text1: Retrieve payment intent by identifier. Returns status and amount.
train_pairs.text2: Fetch payment intent details using its unique ID. Includes status and total charge amount.

train_pairs.text1: Fetches a paginated list of customers sorted by creation timestamp descending.
train_pairs.text2: Retrieves customer records with pagination, ordered by created_at in descending sequence.

train_pairs.text1: Generates an invoice PDF and streams raw binary bytes in the HTTP response.
train_pairs.text2: Creates an invoice record and sends a signed S3 pre-signed download URL.

train_pairs.text1: Searches items matching keyword queries across title and description fields.
train_pairs.text2: Searches items by keyword strictly within item titles. Descriptions are ignored.

train_pairs.text1: Deletes the target user account permanently from database without recovery.
train_pairs.text2: Flags the user account as soft-deleted and disables active logins.

train_pairs.text1: Exports financial transactions as CSV format.
train_pairs.text2: Downloads transaction logs in CSV spreadsheet representation.

train_pairs.text1: Returns current exchange rates for all global fiat currency pairs.
train_pairs.text2: Returns exchange rates for G10 currencies only. Minor currencies discontinued.

train_pairs.text1: Calculates shipping fee based on total weight and destination zip code.
train_pairs.text2: Computes shipping cost using volumetric dimensional weight instead of gross weight.

train_pairs.text1: List warehouse locations for the authenticated merchant.
train_pairs.text2: Lists fulfillment centers associated with the current merchant profile.

train_pairs.text1: Validates promo code and returns discount percentage.
train_pairs.text2: Checks voucher validity; now requires minimum basket total of $50.

train_pairs.text1: Resets user password via email verification link.

train_pairs.text1: Returns order history for the past 24 months.
train_pairs.text2: Retrieves orders from the past 90 days only. Older data archived.

train_pairs.text1: Submits credit card transaction for immediate 3D-Secure authorization.
train_pairs.text2: Submits card payment for 3DS verification with automatic tokenization.

train_pairs.text1: Health check probe endpoint. Returns HTTP 200 with service status UP.
train_pairs.text2: Liveness probe returning 200 OK when operational.

train_pairs.text1: Returns raw GPS telemetry pings every 5 seconds.
train_pairs.text2: Returns smoothed trajectory waypoints aggregated at 60-second intervals.

train_pairs.text1: Creates an API key valid for 1 year.
train_pairs.text2: Generates an API key with mandatory 30-day rotation expiry.

train_pairs.text1: Deletes all items in shopping cart.
train_pairs.text2: Empties the current user's basket.

train_pairs.text1: Fetches audit log entries. Rate limit: 100 requests per minute.
train_pairs.text2: Retrieves audit trails. Rate limit restricted to 20 requests per minute.

train_pairs.text1: Creates user profile. Nickname is optional.

train_pairs.text1: Provides tax calculation breakdown by municipality.
train_pairs.text2: Calculates sales taxes grouped by local city jurisdictions.

train_pairs.text2: Returns meteorological forecasts strictly in Kelvin units.
